titre: Changing schools during the school year (moving, certificat de radiation)
resume: Moving your child to a new primary school, middle school (collège) or high school (lycée) mid-year: certificat de radiation, registration at the town hall then at the school, exact documents, and the case of separated parents.
aQuoiCaSert: A child can change schools during the year, for example after a move or a separation. The change is never automatic: it depends on available places. The previous school issues a certificat de radiation (certificate of withdrawal from the school roll), which you need to enroll the child in the new one. For public nursery and primary schools, registration goes through the town hall (mairie) first.
quiEstConcerne: Parents who move during the school year, within the same town, to another département or to another académie (education region).
Separated parents whose child changes main residence.
Parents who want a different school, collège or lycée from the one in their catchment area.
aSavoir: Public school, another school in the same town: you need the agreement of the mayor, who issues a registration certificate. In another town: agreement of the mayor of your town of residence and of the mayor of the receiving town, who issues the certificate.

Separated parents: if one parent objects to the change of school, the principal must wait for the decision of the family court judge (juge aux affaires familiales, JAF) to whom that parent has applied. Changing schools is an important decision for the child: a written agreement from both parents who hold parental authority is best.
If a judgment gives you sole parental authority, show it to the school and the town hall.

Public collège or lycée in your catchment area: get the certificat de radiation (exeat) from the previous school, then enroll the child at the new one. The head of the school must accept the enrollment. If there are no places left, the DSDEN (direction des services départementaux de l'éducation nationale, the local education authority) assigns the student.

Collège or lycée outside your catchment area: you first need the agreement of the academic director (Dasen, head of the local education authority); if the school is in another département, also that of the academic director of your own département.
Private school: ask the school directly, conditions vary.

documents.libelle: Certificat de radiation from the previous school (exeat for collège and lycée)
documents.detail: Original issued by the previous school's management once the change has been reported. Required in all cases.

documents.libelle: Registration certificate issued by the town hall (public school)
documents.detail: Original, to request from the school services department of the new town's town hall.

documents.libelle: Family record book (livret de famille) or extract of the child's birth certificate
documents.detail: Copy, to prove identity and parentage. Certificate free on service-public.gouv.fr or from the town hall where the child was born.
Copy of the vaccination pages of the health record book (carnet de santé) or a certificate of contraindication.

documents.libelle: ID of each parent making the application
documents.detail: Valid copy, requested by the town hall for registration.
Copy of a bill or rent receipt at the new address. If someone is housing you, a sworn statement (attestation sur l'honneur) from them with their proof of address.

documents.libelle: This year's report cards and guidance decision (collège, lycée)
documents.detail: Copies, downloadable from the school's online portal.

documents.libelle: Written agreement of the other parent
documents.detail: Dated and signed, with a copy of their ID. Recommended when parental authority is shared.

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement (child's residence, parental authority)
documents.detail: Copy, if a decision sets the residence or gives parental authority to one parent only.

etapes.detail: Check that places are still available. For a public school, also contact the town hall's school services department.
Town hall registration certificate for a public school, agreement of the academic director (DSDEN) for a collège or lycée outside your catchment area.

etapes.titre: Inform the previous school that your child is leaving
etapes.detail: Ask for the certificat de radiation or exeat. Let the other parent know.

Certificat de radiation, town hall registration certificate, family record book or birth certificate, up-to-date vaccination record, proof of address, IDs, report cards, written agreement of the other parent or judgment if needed.

etapes.titre: Complete enrollment at the new school
etapes.detail: Remember to re-enroll your child in the canteen, after-school care and school transport too.

ou.nom: Town hall of your new town (school services)
ou.detail: For the registration certificate for a public school. Contact details in the government directory (annuaire de l'administration).

ou.nom: Direction des services départementaux de l'éducation nationale (DSDEN)
ou.detail: For placement in a collège or lycée when the school is full or outside your catchment area. Contact details in the government directory.
